hero.title: Testimonials pattern
hero.description: Use the shared testimonials module for adopter/foster/community stories.

t1.quote: Fostering with our rescue has been an amazing experience. The support, supplies, and guidance made everything manageable.
t1.author: Alex

t2.quote: The adoption process was clear and thoughtful. We felt supported the entire time and found the right dog for our home.
t2.author: Jordan

t3.quote: Our volunteer team works hard, but these stories keep us going. Seeing dogs settle into loving homes is everything.
t3.author: Team Volunteer

longform.quote:
We had never fostered before, and honestly we almost didn't apply. The form asked how much experience we had and the answer was none at all.

Someone called us back the same afternoon anyway.

She walked us through what the first week actually looks like, and then she asked us the questions we hadn't thought to ask ourselves:

"What happens if he doesn't settle?"
"What if our own dog doesn't like him?"
"What if we can't give him back?"

Nobody pretended it would be easy. That is the part I did not expect, and it is the reason we said yes.

Three fosters later, we still call with questions, and somebody still picks up.
longform.pullQuote: Nobody pretended it would be easy.
longform.author: Sam

featured.title: Example — featured (default)
featured.description: Featured layout supports a single highlighted story with optional random selection on load.

grid.title: Grid
grid.description: Grid layout works for standard multi-card sections.

longform.title: Longform
longform.description: Longform renders a single letter-length testimonial as real paragraphs — not italic, no literal quote characters, with an optional pull quote. Blank lines separate paragraphs; a single line break keeps consecutive lines grouped in one paragraph.

standard.title: Standard
items: Use `TestimonialsSection` instead of page-local testimonial markup.
Default behavior shows one random testimonial (`layout="featured"`, `featuredStrategy="randomOnLoad"`) to avoid clutter — just pass `testimonials` and let the defaults apply.
Opt into `layout="grid"` only when a page intentionally wants multiple testimonials shown at once.
Keep testimonials in page/site data files, not inline component internals.
Text content renders server-side without JS — preserve SSR rendering, testimonials must remain readable without JS.
Opt into `layout="longform"` for letter-length testimonials — it renders real paragraphs and picks its single item from `featuredIndex`, never at random.
Give any long testimonial shown in `grid`/`featured` an author-written `excerpt`; never truncate a quote in code.
